same_pass_action: Record acknowledgement date, office, assigned tracking number, and promised response window.
source_note_action: No source-note change unless acknowledgement fixes repository, office, series, or file-unit facts.
selection_decision_action: No selection change; calendar follow-up outside the public site if needed.

same_pass_action: Add tracking number and receiving office to the ledger row.
source_note_action: Do not include tracking number in a FRUS source note unless it becomes part of a release record.

same_pass_action: Record file name, page count, date received, and release status.
source_note_action: Draft or complete source-note row with repository, collection, series, folder, OA/ID or NAID, classification, document type, attachments, and declassification markings.
selection_decision_action: Run promotion gate; if all gates clear, update selection worksheet.

same_pass_action: Record released pages, withheld pages, exemptions, referrals, and appeal/re-review path.
source_note_action: Update visible source-note facts; keep unresolved fields bracketed or named as withheld.
selection_decision_action: Keep as promote/review or hold depending on substance; log terminal-date or fallback issue if needed.

same_pass_action: Record withdrawal-sheet count, exemptions, document titles if visible, and release limitations.
source_note_action: Treat as locator/MDR support; do not draft final source note from withdrawal sheets alone.
selection_decision_action: Hold; use as MDR target unless metadata identifies a stronger pull.

same_pass_action: Record referring office, receiving agency, referral date, and any new tracking number.
source_note_action: Do not close source note; add referral agency as release-status fact if visible.
selection_decision_action: Hold; add follow-up row or note if referral creates a new route.

same_pass_action: Record denial basis, exemptions, appeal deadline, and search/review scope.
source_note_action: No final source note unless a public fallback is selected after documented search.
selection_decision_action: Decide whether to appeal, re-request narrower tabs, use public fallback, or drop.

same_pass_action: Record exact search scope, offices, collections, and date range searched.
source_note_action: Do not treat fact as unavailable; keep missing fields open.
selection_decision_action: Try another office, series, repository, or file-unit lead before fallback.

same_pass_action: Record search scope in enough detail to justify fallback or dropping.
source_note_action: If using fallback, source note must explain why no archival control copy was located.
selection_decision_action: Update selection status to fallback, support, or drop; log decision if it affects a chapter anchor.

same_pass_action: Add a new request row or sub-entry and link it back to original request ID.
source_note_action: Move known repository/series/folder facts to source-note row; do not close until file is reviewed.
selection_decision_action: Keep original candidate open; update send sheet if new target becomes better request.

same_pass_action: Record both file units, page counts, release differences, and which packet is fuller.
source_note_action: Compare source-note control fields; keep fuller control file as likely citation.
selection_decision_action: Update selection worksheet and decision log if control source changes.

same_pass_action: Record public source, page range, and search path that failed to locate archival copy.
source_note_action: Draft fallback note only if compiler accepts public text as final fallback.
selection_decision_action: Keep public source as editorial support unless promotion gate clears fallback use.

same_pass_action: Record meeting title, date, time/place, participants, attachments, and release status.
source_note_action: Draft meeting source note with repository, series, file unit, classification, meeting details, and attachment status.
selection_decision_action: Re-score as selected-document candidate if it shows management machinery.

response_type: Source-note facts complete but document value weak
same_pass_action: Close source-note fields, but mark FRUS action as support or editorial note.
source_note_action: Keep final note only if cited; otherwise retain as support fact.
selection_decision_action: Do not promote; update selection worksheet to support/drop.

same_pass_action: Confirm ledger, source-note row, selection worksheet, and decision log agree.
source_note_action: Remove unresolved brackets or explicitly document unavailable facts.
selection_decision_action: Run every promotion gate before changing status to selected.

same_pass_action: Add follow-up request row and preserve parent request ID.
source_note_action: Carry forward only verified facts; do not infer missing source-note data from referral.
selection_decision_action: Update action board or send sheet only if follow-up becomes priority route.
